extraction.Name: Louise Golomb (Koch) (deceased)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 27, 1918 by Joe Koch, husband of allottee
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the State of South Dakota for $6000 (released April 1, 1919); mortgaged to C.H. Townsend for $6000 due March 20, 1920 (released March 8, 1920); mortgaged to Lloyd C. Lamphere for $10,000 (assigned to Rock Island Saving Bank and foreclosed for $13,986.36 in 1924); Sheriff executed a deed in favor of Rock Island Saving Bank on March 31, 1925
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612778; Lots 3 and 4, and East half of Southwest quarter, section 7, township 99, north of range 76; receipt signed by the allottee but not dated; on February 13, 1919, Louise and Joseph Koch mortgaged this and some other land to the State of South Dakota for $6000; on March 28, 1919, Louise and Joseph Koch mortgaged this and some other land to C.H. Townsend for $6000 due March 20, 1920; on January 24, 1920, Louise and Joseph Koch mortgaged this and some other land to Lloyd C. Lamphere for $10,000; mortgage assigned to Rock Island Saving Bank and foreclosed for $13,986.36 in 1924; Sheriff executed deed in favor of Rock Island Saving Bank on March 31, 1925
